title: Payment Arrangement Terms: Arrangement Balance and First Instalment on Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
content:
**Arrangement balance.** For a payment arrangement on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription, the arrangement balance is the balance owed on the subscription when the arrangement is made.

**Instalments.** The arrangement settles the arrangement balance in **three** equal monthly instalments, with nothing due up front:

- the amount spread is the arrangement balance;
- it is divided into three equal shares;
- the first instalment is the amount due up front, which is nothing, plus one share;
- the first instalment is therefore one third of the arrangement balance.

**Rounding.** The first instalment is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Inputs and their record

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Arrangement balance | the balance owed shown on the subscription record when the arrangement is made |
| Number of instalments | 3 |
| Amount due up front | nothing |

## Worked examples (hypothetical balances)

| Arrangement balance | One share (one third) | First instalment |
|---|---|---|
| 1500.00 USD | 500.00 | 500.00 USD |
| 1000.00 USD | 333.3333 | 333.33 USD |
| 2000.00 USD | 666.6667 | 666.67 USD |

The remaining two instalments settle the rest of the arrangement balance in equal monthly amounts.
